BiblicalUsage: He' is an Aramaic word for lo, behold, a finger pointing at something, and Daniel uses it twice. In Daniel 2:43 it points at the kingdoms that will mingle but not hold together, and in Daniel 3:25 it points at the fourth man walking in the fire, loose and unhurt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses show both sides of the word: lo, the kingdoms fall apart, and lo, the Son of God walks in the fire with his people.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
